design.criterion: Minimize worst Fisher variance of residual r/4 on the 16 nominal (p,r) pairs, at T=8000, before Monte Carlo evaluation.
design.four_settings: Endpoints plus any two of five equally spaced interior grid points.
design.scope: Finite candidate optimization of setting locations and signal allocation; no claim of unrestricted optimality.

basis_sampling: Per transmitted signal: matched rectilinear .25, matched diagonal .25, discarded .5; errors sampled conditional on the two matched counts.
other_sampling: Each allocated setting uses Binomial(Tj,.5) sifted shots, then Binomial(Nj,Qj) errors. All allocations sum to T.
pairing: Method acquisitions are independent within a replicate block; multiple estimators of one acquisition reuse exactly its counts.
estimation: Weighted nonlinear least squares with Jeffreys plug-in variances, signed r in [-.5,1.5], p in [1e-8,min(.3,.999/max(f))]. Basis-only fits use p upper bound .3. An unbounded analytic basis inverse is a declared sensitivity estimator when its square root is real.
intervals: Unclipped individual 95% local-Wald intervals, empirical coverage with Wilson Monte Carlo intervals. Fixed-grid mean MAE uncertainty uses independent cell replicate variances. No equivalence margin is prespecified.

holdout.models: Equal-noise basis-single, equal-noise aggregate two/four, and independently unknown (pA,pB,r) aggregate four. Same four-setting counts for its two model fits.
holdout.prediction_check: Compare held-out proportion with model prediction using sum of independent sampling variance and parameter delta variance; report 95% prediction coverage. Held-out counts are never fitted.
holdout.curvature_law: f_effective = f + epsilon*f*(f-1), which preserves both the operating setting and zero-noise limit.
holdout.independent_device_fitter: Profile pA on a fixed 129-point grid and refine every local minimum; at each pA solve the constrained quadratic problem in d=1-r/2, k=d*pB exactly, including all boundary edges.

references: Check closed-form basis and unequal-device laws by explicit density states. Independently profile one-dimensional WLS for fixed selected replicates and boundary cases; independently check three-parameter fits and analytic Jacobians.
scope: No new reconciliation codes, pooling-rule training, or rate-policy training in this validation.
